name: Account Connectors
description: Connect accounts through official MCP services, with explicit authorization and setup requirements.

connector.title: Notion
connector.description: Search and work with the Notion workspace you authorize.

connector.title: GitHub
connector.description: Work with repositories through GitHub's official MCP server.
connector.setup_required: Wuu must register and configure its own GitHub App or OAuth client before account connection is available. The server URL alone does not enable OAuth.

connector.title: Google Drive
connector.description: Google Drive's official MCP server is in Developer Preview.
connector.setup_required: Requires Workspace Developer Preview membership, a Cloud project with the Drive and MCP APIs enabled, and a registered Desktop OAuth client for an AI-powered agent with consent and scopes configured.

interface.shortDescription: Connect accounts only when you choose to authorize them.
